description.value:
Trigger A creature targets you with a Strike, but the result has not been revealed.

Frequency once per encounter

You expend a Focus Point or a 1st-rank or higher spell slot to swap places with a log, rock, or other unattended Medium object within your reach. The triggering Strike resolves against the substitute (treat it as having your AC and 1 HP). You move up to half your Speed to an unoccupied square within line of effect of the triggering creature.
